hero.title: Net Zero Goals
hero.subtitle: Aligning Compleo Health's sustainability initiatives with NHS Net Zero requirements to deliver comprehensive carbon reduction and social value.

timeline.title: NHS Requirements & Compleo Response Timeline
timeline.subtitle: Our strategic roadmap shows how Compleo Health's initiatives directly align with and exceed NHS Net Zero requirements, ensuring full compliance and environmental leadership.

timelineItems.title: Carbon Reduction Plan for Major NHS Contracts
timelineItems.description: Suppliers must publish a Carbon Reduction Plan for all new NHS contracts over £5 million/year, covering UK Scope 1, 2, and some Scope 3 emissions (per PPN 06/21).

timelineItems.title: 10% Net Zero and Social Value Weighting
timelineItems.description: All NHS procurements include a minimum 10% weighting for Net Zero and Social Value. Strategy focuses on delivering health-specific outcomes and supporting NHS sustainability goals.

timelineItems.title: Initial Carbon Reduction Plan
timelineItems.description: Developed an initial Carbon Reduction Plan, laying the foundation for long-term alignment with the NHS Net Zero ambition and compliance with PPN 06/21.

timelineItems.title: Extended Carbon Requirements
timelineItems.description: Carbon Reduction Requirement extends to all new NHS procurements, regardless of contract value.

timelineItems.title: Carbon Reduction Strategy Update
timelineItems.description: Update our Carbon Reduction Strategy to reflect rapid growth and align with the NHS Net Zero ambition, using a clear emissions baseline from 2022-2024.

timelineItems.title: Sustainability and Social Value Strategy
timelineItems.description: Continue to develop our Sustainability and Social Value Strategy, aligned with NHS Social Value Model (PPN 06/20 & 02/21). Embed environmental, economic, and community value across all procurement value chains.

timelineItems.title: Full Carbon Footprint Assessment
timelineItems.description: Expand strategic focus to include full carbon footprint assessment, with emphasis on integrating Scope 3 emissions into our planning and reporting.

timelineItems.title: Community-Focused Outcomes
timelineItems.description: Deliver measurable, community-focused outcomes across operations. Strengthen alignment with NHS social impact goals through ongoing strategy refinement and performance tracking.

timelineItems.title: Comprehensive Carbon Reduction Plan
timelineItems.description: All suppliers must publicly report emissions and targets, publish a Carbon Reduction Plan covering global Scope 1, 2 & 3 emissions, and align with the NHS Net Zero target.

timelineItems.title: Comprehensive Carbon Reduction Plan Publication
timelineItems.description: Finalise and publish a comprehensive Carbon Reduction Plan, covering all emission scopes, aligned with NHS requirements (PPN 06/21) and subject to annual review.

cta.subtitle: Contact our sustainability team to learn more about how Compleo Health can support your organisation's Net Zero objectives while delivering exceptional diagnostic services.
